Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, NOT a UI mockup. Use the supplied Sandbox Wars mockup ONLY as the character identity and pixel-art style reference. Output a square transparent PNG sprite atlas with EXACTLY NINE equally sized square cells in a 3-column by 3-row grid. Cell divisions at exactly one third and two thirds of canvas. All character pixels must remain inside their own cell with generous clear padding. Full-body cells have common body proportions and scale: standing fighter height 78% of cell height, head near 12% from top, feet touching a fixed baseline at 91% from top. Horizontally centered, three-quarter SIDE view FACING RIGHT in every cell. Consistent light from above, no cast shadows. Sharp attractive 16-bit arcade pixel art, deliberate visible square-pixel clusters, dark outlines, restrained shading ramps, NO soft painterly edges, no photorealism. No robots.

1 TOP LEFT: full-body clean idle fighting stance, guard raised, knees softly bent.
2 TOP CENTER: same idle stance at same exact scale and foot placement, shoulders two pixels lower.
3 TOP RIGHT: same idle stance, shoulders four pixels lower and knees subtly more bent.
4 MIDDLE LEFT: same idle stance shoulders two pixels lower.
5 MIDDLE CENTER: same idle stance at initial height, small breathing motion.
6 MIDDLE RIGHT: same idle stance shoulders two pixels higher. The six frames form a subtle looping bounce, NOT six different poses. Feet never slide, face and outfit never change.

8 BOTTOM CENTER: same battered character full-body TIRED VICTORY pose, upright enough to raise one weary fist, wry exhausted smile, same torn sleeve and bandage, same ground baseline, top of raised fist stays inside cell padding. No blood.
9 BOTTOM RIGHT: clean head-and-shoulders portrait of this exact character, enlarged to fill 78% of cell, transparent background, facing right.
The 8 full-body cells must be animation-ready and tightly consistent. Pose differences only where requested. This sheet is intended to be cut into nine equal square frames.
Character: the DAYTONA-inspired cyan fighter from the left of the reference. A lean young adult male street fighter, warm medium skin, unruly swept-up black hair with vivid electric-cyan tips, open cropped charcoal tech jacket with cyan shoulder and sleeve trims, light gray tank shirt, dark charcoal cargo pants, fingerless black gloves, chunky black high-top sneakers with cyan soles and accents. Recognizable energetic silhouette. No writing or brand marks on clothing. Keep jacket, hair shape and all details identical across the six idle frames.
